title: Experience becomes evidence
goal: Relacionar experiencias previas con una situación presente y distinguirlas de eventos fechados.
strategy: Buscá las referencias temporales antes de elegir un tiempo: last year sitúa un evento terminado; so far mantiene abierto el período. Preguntate por qué la experiencia importa ahora.
passage: When I applied for a place in the community research project, I worried about my lack of experience. I have never worked in a laboratory, but I have volunteered at a nature centre for three years. Last summer, I helped a team count birds near the river. We collected observations every morning and published a short report in August. Since then, I have become more interested in how people use evidence. The project coordinator has already read my application. She called yesterday and asked me to bring the report to an interview. I haven’t received a place yet, but I have learned that experience can take more than one form.
questions: Which experience continues up to the present?
“I have volunteered … for three years” conecta la actividad con el presente; las otras acciones tienen referencias terminadas.
Yes, the coordinator read the application.
“I haven’t received a place yet” deja la aceptación pendiente. Una entrevista no equivale a admisión.
task: Escribí un perfil de 120–150 palabras para un proyecto. Combiná experiencia acumulada, un ejemplo fechado y algo que todavía no hiciste. Usá for o since de manera pertinente.
model: I have helped at a neighbourhood learning centre since 2023. I have organised reading sessions and supported new volunteers, although I have never managed a large project. Last October, I prepared a short guide for families who were using the centre for the first time. Three other volunteers reviewed it, and we distributed it during an open day. Since that experience, I have become more interested in accessible communication. I have already completed an introductory design course, but I haven’t studied research methods yet. I would like to join your project because it connects education with community work. I can contribute practical experience and a willingness to ask questions when I do not understand something. This opportunity would also help me understand how a team turns observations into useful questions.
checklist: Elegí pasado simple con fechas terminadas.
Usé since con un punto de inicio y for con una duración.
Relacioné la experiencia con el objetivo actual.
contrast: I have volunteered here since three years.
I have volunteered here for three years.
For introduce duración; since introduce el momento de inicio.
